update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.30 - Installs alongside the original app
Changed ------- - The fork now uses its own application id (com.staticwitt.uma_android_automation), so Android treats it as a separate app from steve1316's original. Installing this no longer replaces (or conflicts with) the upstream app - the two live side by side. The app label gains a "Fork" suffix so you can tell them apart in the launcher.
One-time migration (first install of this version) -------------------------------------------------- A new application id means Android sees a brand-new app with empty data, so this version will NOT upgrade your current install in place - it appears as a separate app. 1. Export your settings from your existing install BEFORE updating. 2. Install this APK - it appears as a second app; the old one stays. 3. Import your settings in the new app and re-grant permissions (Accessibility, Display over other apps, battery exemption). 4. Uninstall the old app whenever you are done with it.
